primary.summary: Perp participation-commitment cross-section: ride moves confirmed by rising open interest (long price-up/OI-up, short price-down/OI-up), fade or stand aside from OI-falling covering/liquidation moves.
primary.mechanism: In perp markets every price move carries an observable commitment signature: moves on RISING open interest are driven by new capital initiating positions and tend to extend, while moves on FALLING open interest are position-closing flow — short-covering rallies and long-liquidation dumps — that exhausts itself and carries no follow-through. Ranking the top-40 cross-section by OI-confirmed displacement monetizes the robust 8h-3d flow-persistence my ledgered e01-e03 experiments measured in this exact universe, but only where the positioning ledger says the move is committed. The mechanism is perp-native (OI is the perp market's positioning ledger, unavailable to spot markets) and lives on a different data axis from every price-only momentum/trend family.
primary.falsifier: If, over the OI-covered IS window, OI-conditioned continuation shows no net@1x Sharpe >= 0.5 plateau on the pre-registered grid, OR the OI conditioning adds nothing over unconditioned price continuation (conditioned-minus-unconditioned Sharpe <= 0, i.e. the commitment signature is not load-bearing), the family is dead.
